title: Open Workout Schema v0: workout
description: One workout: exercise entries with their sets, plus where the record came from. Draft; may change until v1.

id.description: Assigned by the server that stores the workout.

started_at.description: When the workout started. Listed in estimates as /started_at when it was worked out (from a day alone, or the time it was logged) rather than given: trust its day, not its hour.

paused_s.description: Whole seconds between started_at and ended_at during which the session was paused. Active time is ended_at - started_at - paused_s. Absent means unknown (read as 0); 0 means there were no pauses.

date.description: The workout's local day: started_at in timezone. A reader files the workout under this day, wherever the reader is.

timezone.description: The IANA time zone the workout happened in (America/Chicago), so its local day stays put across daylight-saving changes and when the person moves.

updated_at.description: When the stored record last changed, by the server's clock: the workout, an entry, a set or the program label. For mirroring; absent from a document that was never stored.

merged_sources.description: Other records of the same session, merged into this one: the same run from two apps, say. This workout is the fullest of them.

routine.description: The routine this workout was started from: a label, like program. id is the routine's ID in the same log or server, or null once the routine is deleted; name is its name when the workout started.

totals.description: What a device or app reported for the whole session, never a sum of the sets. A reader uses these for the session and set values for the sets, and doesn't add one to the other.

duration_s.description: The time the device recorded, which can differ from ended_at - started_at.

heart_rate_bpm.description: Average heart rate over the session, in beats per minute, as reported.

reported_by.description: The device or app that reported them, e.g. Apple Watch.

program.description: The program day this workout was part of: a label, which changes nothing else here. listed false means the program was withdrawn, and says nothing more.

estimates.description: JSON pointers (RFC 6901) to values that were inferred or assumed rather than given.

ows_version.description: The Open Workout Schema version the document was written to, as MAJOR.MINOR ("0.1"). A document without one is 0.0, the drafts before versions were numbered (SPEC.md, section 8).

source.description: Provenance: where the record came from.

client.description: The client or app, e.g. claude, strong, hevy.

external_id.description: The workout's ID in the app it was imported from.

id.description: Assigned by the server; used to edit the entry.

text.description: What the user called the exercise.

exercise.description: The exercise an entry was matched to. catalogue and custom are confirmed; close and unmatched need confirmation and never count toward records.

id.description: Open Exercise Catalogue ID (oec:<slug>) or a custom exercise ID; null when nothing matched.
Assigned by the server; used to edit the set.

calories.description: Kilocalories, as a machine or app reported them.

heart_rate_bpm.description: Average heart rate over the set, in beats per minute.

steps.description: Steps taken during the set, as entered or as a device reported them. Never a day's total.

completed_at.description: When the set was done: marked done by the person or recorded by a device. Listed in estimates when worked out instead (sets spaced across a workout logged afterwards, say).

load.description: A weight in the unit the user gave it.
